skipped.message: DEFECT: OPENAI_CUSTOM_HEADERS in the environment replaces the outgoing Authorization header, so the request leaves with a credential the caller never passed. Fix: make_client should pass default_headers={'Authorization': f'Bearer {key}'}, which makes the SDK drop an env-supplied Authorization.

DEFECT (minor): OPENAI_ORG_ID and OPENAI_PROJECT_ID from the environment are sent as OpenAI-Organization / OpenAI-Project headers to openrouter.ai. Fix: pass those headers as Omit() in default_headers, or pass organization/project explicitly.

DEFECT (minor): a key with surrounding whitespace is returned verbatim; a trailing newline (the usual result of a copy-paste or of $(cat keyfile)) then fails as APIConnectionError 'Connection error.', which names neither the key nor the whitespace. Fix: strip the resolved key, or refuse it with the usual message.
